alignment_statement: User-requested architecture-aligned scratch retraining: HiFi-GAN V1 Generator + MPD + UnivNet MRD, with MSD removed. This deliberately differs from FastVoiceGrad's frozen pretrained Generator; the papers do not publish an independent modified-vocoder training recipe or checkpoint. Undisclosed standalone-vocoder settings are inherited from the official HiFi-GAN V1 VCTK experiment and are never presented as author-exact FastVoiceGrad facts.

undisclosed_choice_notes.exact_split_ids: The paper gives the 100-train-speaker/10-test-speaker and 10-sentence design but not the exact IDs. This run uses the separately attested high-confidence official-demo reconstruction in split_protocol.json.
undisclosed_choice_notes.max_steps: FastVoiceGrad does not disclose independent vocoder duration. 2,500,000 steps is inherited from the official HiFi-GAN VCTK experiment because this is a modified HiFi-GAN V1 on VCTK; a 1,000,000-step intermediate is archived, but 1M is not treated as the final paper setting.
undisclosed_choice_notes.initialization: The papers explicitly use a pretrained/frozen HiFi-GAN V1 Generator. Training Generator, MPD, and MRD from scratch is a deliberate user-requested deviation; the exact author initialization checkpoint is not published.
undisclosed_choice_notes.standalone_vocoder_training_scope: FastVoiceGrad freezes pretrained V during diffusion training and does not publish a standalone modified-vocoder training recipe. Joint scratch G+MPD+MRD training is therefore a user-requested architecture-aligned derived experiment, not an author-exact claim.
undisclosed_choice_notes.conditioning_interface: Scratch vocoder training follows official HiFi-GAN peak-normalize*0.95 conditioning, while the already-trained VoiceGrad teacher produces the project's DiffVC-style raw-amplitude log-mel domain. The papers do not disclose their exact amplitude-interface treatment; no unreported inference compensation is introduced here.
undisclosed_choice_notes.validation: The paper does not publish a vocoder validation split or selection rule. This run uses no validation and never selects on the held-out test set.
undisclosed_choice_notes.checkpoint_policy: Checkpoint frequency is an engineering/storage choice and does not change the model or optimization equations.
undisclosed_choice_notes.mrd_stft_center_and_padding: The cited paper gives STFT resolutions and the layer diagram but not every library flag. This run follows the widely used maum-ai UnivNet reference implementation: reflect-pad by (n_fft-hop)/2 and call STFT with center=False; that repository is an unofficial implementation, so this remains a declared engineering choice.
